exposure: metabolites in maternal serum (28 weeks gestation)
cohort: 912 mother-child pairs from the Barwon Infant Study pre-birth cohort
finding: Delivery mode, infant sex, gestational age, and birth weight were associated with specific cord blood metabolite levels at birth, including those implicated in later risk of cardiometabolic disease.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was associated with many cord blood metabolite differences, including those implicated in later risk of cardiometabolic disease.
birth_weight: Birth weight was associated with specific cord blood metabolite levels
